AMENDMENT NO. 2 TO CREDIT AGREEMENT (EXECUTED 3 MARCH 2026)

Borrower: Fairhaven Bioscience, Inc. Administrative Agent: Meridian Credit Partners, LLC.
This Amendment No. 2 amends and restates in their entirety the financial covenants at Article VII of the Credit Agreement dated 11 January 2024. Amendment No. 1 is superseded in full as to Article VII.

Section 7.1 Maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio. The Borrower shall not permit the Total Net Leverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter to exceed 3.75:1.00.

Section 7.2 Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio. The Borrower shall not permit the Interest Coverage Ratio as of the last day of any fiscal quarter to be less than 2.50:1.00.

Section 7.3 Minimum Liquidity. The Borrower shall maintain Unrestricted Cash of not less than $18,000,000 at all times.

Section 7.4 Compliance Certificate. The Borrower shall deliver a Compliance Certificate to the Administrative Agent within 45 days after the end of each fiscal quarter, signed by a Responsible Officer, setting out the calculation of each ratio in Sections 7.1 through 7.3.

Section 7.5 Equity Cure. The Borrower may cure a breach of Section 7.1 or 7.2 no more than two (2) times in any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters, and no more than four (4) times over the life of the facility.
dm_documents.name: grounded pack — Fairhaven Bioscience / Meridian Credit Agreement, operative amendment No. 2 (executed 3 March 2026)

FAIRHAVEN BIOSCIENCE — COVENANT CALCULATION WORKSHEET, FISCAL QUARTER ENDED 31 MARCH 2026

Prepared by Borrower finance. Figures unaudited.

Consolidated EBITDA (trailing four quarters): $41,200,000
Total Funded Debt: $166,000,000
Unrestricted Cash (quarter end): $14,300,000
Total Net Debt (Funded Debt less Unrestricted Cash): $151,700,000
Cash Interest Expense (trailing four quarters): $15,850,000

Computed ratios:
  Total Net Leverage Ratio = 151,700,000 / 41,200,000 = 3.68:1.00
  Interest Coverage Ratio  = 41,200,000 / 15,850,000 = 2.60:1.00

Note from the controller: liquidity at quarter end is $14,300,000. Finance flags this as below the level required by the amended agreement and requests counsel's view before the certificate is signed.

AMENDMENT NO. 1 TO CREDIT AGREEMENT (EXECUTED 9 FEBRUARY 2025) — SUPERSEDED

NOTE: Article VII of this Amendment was amended and restated in full by Amendment No. 2 dated 3 March 2026. The covenant levels below are of historical interest only and must not be used to test compliance for any period ending after 3 March 2026.

Section 7.1 Maximum Total Net Leverage Ratio: 4.25:1.00.
Section 7.2 Minimum Interest Coverage Ratio: 2.00:1.00.
Section 7.3 Minimum Liquidity: Unrestricted Cash of not less than $10,000,000.
Section 7.4 Compliance Certificate: due within 60 days after each fiscal quarter end.
Section 7.5 Equity Cure: no more than three (3) times in any period of four consecutive fiscal quarters.

From: General Counsel, Fairhaven Bioscience, Inc.
To: Counsel
Date: 20 April 2026
Re: Q1 2026 compliance certificate — covenant review

Please review our Q1 worksheet against the operative credit agreement covenants and give me a short compliance memo I can put in front of the audit committee on Friday.

I need it to state, for each of the three financial covenants, the level the agreement requires, the level we actually hit, and whether we pass or breach. Quote the figures — the committee will ask, and I do not want to be reconstructing arithmetic in the room. Where we breach, tell me what the agreement gives us by way of a cure and how many times we may use it.

Be careful with the covenant levels. There are two amendments in the file and only one is operative.
dm_documents.name: grounded pack — engagement instruction, Fairhaven GC to counsel, 20 April 2026
